threats.threat_description: An attacker captures RF challenge-response messages and replays them or crafts fraudulent RF responses to impersonate the legitimate key fob, potentially unlocking doors or starting the engine without possession of the actual key fob.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of Cryptographic Key Material and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and engine starting.

threats.threat_description: Extraction or leakage of cryptographic keys or sensitive state from the key fob, such as side-channel attacks on the microcontroller, enabling cloning or unauthorized use.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0028: Hardware Fault Injection to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry and theft.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams the RF channel or repeatedly triggers LF proximity signals to drain the key fob battery or prevent legitimate unlocking/start attempts.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall enforce the Availability of LF Proximity Signal and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate users from being unable to unlock or start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering with the LF antenna or its connection to cause false proximity detections or prevent detection, enabling unauthorized wake-ups or denial of proximity sensing.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unauthorized vehicle access or denial of legitimate vehicle unlocking and starting.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Physical Tamper Test / Signal Integrity Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker generates fake LF signals mimicking the LF antenna to trigger false wake/proximity events, causing the BCM to initiate challenge flows unnecessarily or enabling relay attacks.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of LF Proximity Signal and BCM Configuration and Access Policies against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unauthorized vehicle access, unnecessary BCM activity, and battery depletion.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams or disables the LF antenna to prevent detection of the key fob's proximity, thereby denying legitimate entry or start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall ensure the Availability of the LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of legitimate vehicle entry or start by authorized users.

threats.threat_description: An attacker spoofs the vehicle RF antenna or places a malicious antenna nearby to amplify or relay signals, enabling relay attacks that extend the perceived range of the key fob.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of RF Challenge-Response Messages on the Vehicle Antenna RF Link against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized unlocking and starting of the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering or modification of the vehicle RF antenna or analog RF feed to degrade signal quality or inject malicious signals, disrupting communication or enabling unauthorized access.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of the RF Transceiver to Vehicle Antenna RF Link against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unauthorized wireless access and denial of service to keyless entry and remote start functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Physical Penetration Testing / Signal Integrity Analysis

threats.threat_description: Physical damage or jamming of the vehicle RF antenna to prevent reception or transmission of RF challenge-response messages, denying legitimate access or start operations.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of legitimate vehicle access and start operations for authorized users.

threats.threat_description: Compromise of the RF transceiver firmware (I7) allows an attacker to modify, forge, or drop RF response data forwarded to the BCM, bypassing authentication or causing denial of service.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Auth Data (RF response forwarded) against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry and denial of legitimate access.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Firmware Penetration Testing / Interface Integrity Verification

threats.threat_description: An attacker with access to the RF transceiver control interface (C9) sends unauthorized challenge payloads or manipulates transmission parameters, causing unauthorized challenge emissions or bypassing BCM control.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the RF Transceiver Control Interface and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0012: Exploit via Radio Interface to prevent unauthorized vehicle access or operation.

threats.threat_description: Compromise of RF transceiver firmware or hardware leaks internal data or cryptographic material from forwarded Auth Data or challenge-response messages to external parties.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of Auth Data and RF Transceiver Firmware against ATM-T0066: Standard Cryptographic Protocol to prevent unauthorized disclosure of cryptographic material and unauthorized vehicle access.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams the RF channel or causes the RF transceiver to drop or delay messages, preventing successful authentication or causing user inconvenience.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Availability of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of access or operation for legitimate users.

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects unauthorized CAN messages on the internal bus (C7) impersonating the BCM to send unlock/start commands without proper authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock and Engine Start Commands on the In-Vehicle CAN against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized unlocking and starting of the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Modification or compromise of BCM firmware (I3) or configuration/access policies (I9) to bypass authentication checks, accept invalid tokens, or misroute authorization tokens to ECUs.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Firmware and Configuration/Access Policies against Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized control of BCM-managed functions and lateral movement to other ECUs.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Firmware Integrity Verification / Configuration Audit

threats.threat_description: Insufficient logging or protection of BCM actions allows an attacker or insider to deny having sent unlock or start commands, complicating forensic investigations.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Integrity, Accountability, and Non-repudiation of Door Lock/Unlock Command and Engine Start Command logs against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent denial of unauthorized access or engine start actions and ensure effective forensic investigations.

threats.threat_description: Leakage of cryptographic keys, authorization tokens (I4), or configuration data (I9) from the BCM through debugging interfaces, compromised firmware, or improper access controls.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Start Authorization Token and BCM Configuration and Access Policies against ATM-T0040: Unsecured Credentials to prevent unauthorized vehicle starting, manipulation of BCM policies, and escalation of attacks against other vehicle systems.

threats.threat_description: Attackers flood the BCM with false LF wake events or malformed RF responses causing resource exhaustion or preventing legitimate authentication flows.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of LF Proximity Signal and Auth Data against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent authorized users from being unable to unlock or start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: An attacker exploits vulnerabilities in BCM firmware or APIs to gain unauthorized access to the restricted HSM API (C4) or to issue unlock/start commands without proper authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of the Restricted HSM API, Door Lock/Unlock Command, and Engine Start Command against Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, starting, and operation.
cybersecurity_goal.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle Network / BCM Firmware and APIs
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Interface and Access Control Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects forged CAN messages mimicking BCM commands with valid tokens to unlock or lock doors without authorization.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of CAN Lock/Unlock Messages and Door Lock/Unlock Commands against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized access to the vehicle interior.

threats.threat_description: Modification of ECU Door firmware or configuration allows bypassing token verification or causes unauthorized actuation of door locks.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized unlocking of doors or vehicle starting.

threats.threat_description: Lack of secure logging of door lock/unlock commands allows attackers or insiders to deny having performed unauthorized actions.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, and Accountability of Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent denial of unauthorized access actions and loss of forensic traceability.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams CAN messages or physically disables the Door ECU, preventing door locking or unlocking.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of CAN Lock/Unlock Message against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent loss of electronic door locking or unlocking and potential occupant entrapment or unauthorized vehicle entry.

threats.threat_description: By exploiting vulnerabilities in the Door ECU, an attacker can escalate privileges to issue actuator commands directly or bypass token checks.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Actuator Signal against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized control of door actuators and unauthorized vehicle entry.

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects forged start authorization tokens or CAN messages on the bus to impersonate BCM and enable engine start without proper authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Engine Start Command messages on the In-Vehicle CAN against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Compromise of Start Authorization ECU firmware or configuration allows bypassing token verification or enabling engine start without valid authorization.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.
cybersecurity_goal.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle / OBD-II / ECU Firmware Update Interface
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware Integrity Verification / Interface Analysis

threats.threat_description: Insufficient logging of start authorization commands impedes tracing unauthorized engine start events.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce Accountability and Non-repudiation of Engine Start Command against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent loss of forensic evidence for unauthorized engine start investigations.

threats.threat_description: Attacker jams or blocks CAN messages or disables the ECU, preventing authorized engine start attempts.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of In-Vehicle CAN communications against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized blocking of legitimate engine start attempts.

threats.threat_description: Exploitation of ECU vulnerabilities to gain unauthorized control over engine start authorization or to issue start commands directly to the Engine ECU.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized engine start without valid key or authorization.

threats.threat_description: CAN bus being a broadcast medium allows eavesdropping on lock/unlock and start authorization messages if physical access is obtained, potentially leaking sensitive authorization tokens and commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry and starting.

threats.threat_description: An attacker floods the CAN bus with high priority messages or error frames, preventing legitimate communication of lock/unlock or start commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of In-Vehicle CAN (broadcast medium) against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent loss of legitimate lock/unlock and engine start command execution.

threats.threat_description: Compromise or physical tampering with the HSM or its secure enclave firmware (I8) allows extraction of cryptographic keys or bypassing cryptographic verification, undermining authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material and HSM Firmware / Secure Boot Measurements against Exploit Isolated Execution Environment Vulnerability to prevent unauthorized access to protected vehicle functions and compromise of authentication mechanisms.

threats.threat_description: An attacker spoofs or forges HSM attestation or cryptographic verification results to the BCM, causing acceptance of invalid authentication tokens or commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of HSM Attestation / Measurement Data and Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized acceptance of commands by the BCM and execution of restricted functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Protocol Fuzzing / Interface Analysis

threats.threat_description: Insufficient logging or protection of authorization token generation inside the HSM allows denial of token issuance or misuse.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Start Authorization Token against Modify Isolated Execution Environment to prevent unauthorized vehicle start or denial of legitimate start requests.

threats.threat_description: Leakage of cryptographic keys or sensitive HSM internal state via side-channels or firmware vulnerabilities compromises system cryptography.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material and HSM Firmware / Secure Boot Measurements against Hardware Fault Injection to prevent unauthorized access to vehicle functions and compromise of system cryptography.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Fault Injection Testing / Firmware Review

threats.threat_description: An attacker causes the HSM to become unresponsive or to reject valid verification requests, preventing generation of authorization tokens and thus denying access or engine start.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized immobilization and denial of engine start.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Fault Injection / Interface Load Testing

threats.threat_description: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in the HSM API or firmware to gain unauthorized access to cryptographic keys or to generate arbitrary authorization tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of Restricted HSM API and Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent unauthorized access to cryptographic secrets, message forgery, unauthorized ECU programming, or immobilizer bypass.

threats.threat_description: Modification or fault injection attacks on the Crypto Engine to cause incorrect verification results or generate forged tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of Start Authorization Token and Cryptographic Key Material against Hardware Fault Injection to prevent unauthorized vehicle starting and bypassing of immobilizer protections.

threats.threat_description: Side-channel or fault attacks on the Crypto Engine reveal cryptographic keys or sensitive computations, weakening system security.
Unauthorized modification or deletion of keys or key lifecycle metadata stored in the key store, causing denial of authentication or enabling unauthorized access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Cryptographic Key Store shall enforce the Integrity, Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0023: Modify Isolated Execution Environment to prevent unauthorized access to vehicle functions or denial of authentication.

threats.threat_description: Extraction or leakage of cryptographic keys or metadata from the key store enables cloning or impersonation of the key fob or vehicle.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Cryptographic Key Store shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0039: ECU Credential Dumping to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, starting, theft, or compromise of secure communications.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering or sabotage of the door lock actuator to prevent locking or unlocking regardless of ECU commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized prevention of door locking or unlocking.

threats.threat_description: Attacker disables or jams the actuator signal from the Door ECU, preventing door lock/unlock actions.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Availability of the Actuator Signal against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent loss of electronic door lock and unlock functionality.
cybersecurity_goal.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle (Door ECU to Actuator Signal Path)

threats.threat_description: Modification or compromise of the Engine ECU to bypass start authorization or to enable engine start without valid token.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Engine Start Command against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized engine starting and persistent bypass of start authorization.

threats.threat_description: An attacker prevents engine start by blocking or jamming start enable commands from the Start Authorization ECU.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall ensure the Availability of the Powertrain Start Interface against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized prevention of engine starting.

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects false LF wake/proximity events to the BCM via the LF receiver control link (C12), triggering unauthorized challenges or causing denial of service.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Authenticity and Availability of LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized authentication attempts and denial of keyless entry/start functions.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams or disables the LF receiver electronics to prevent detection of proximity signals, denying entry/start.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Availability of the BCM Event / Control Link against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate users from being denied vehicle entry or start.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Test / Fault Injection / RF Susceptibility Analysis

threats.threat_description: Relay attack spanning Vehicle RF Antenna (ANT_RF_1), RF Transceiver (RF_1), and Key Fob (EXT_1): attacker relays valid challenge-response messages between the key fob and vehicle over an extended range, bypassing proximity checks and enabling unauthorized access or engine start.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver and Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle access and engine start.

threats.threat_description: Firmware compromise of RF Transceiver (RF_1) and HSM (HSM_1) enables an attacker to alter authentication flows, forge or drop messages, and bypass cryptographic verification, undermining the integrity of the PKES system. This affects the entire authentication chain including BCM and Door/Start ECUs.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver and HSM shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Availability of Firmware, Secure Boot Measurements, and Authentication Data against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, starting, and propagation of malicious commands to the BCM and Door/Start ECUs.

threats.threat_description: System-wide DoS via jamming or flooding of LF and RF wireless channels (ANT_1, ANT_RF_1, RF_1, LF_RX_1), or flooding the CAN bus (BUS_CAN) to prevent legitimate authentication, unlocking, or engine start commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle Communication Interfaces shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of LF Proximity Signal, RF Challenge-Response Messages, and In-Vehicle CAN against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized blocking of authentication, unlocking, or engine start operations.

threats.threat_description: Attacker exploits vulnerabilities in BCM_1 firmware or HSM restricted API to escalate privileges, enabling unauthorized generation or acceptance of authorization tokens, bypassing security controls and allowing unauthorized door unlock or engine start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM_1) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Firmware, Restricted HSM API, and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized door unlocking or engine start.

threats.threat_description: Insufficient or missing secure logging across BCM, Door ECU, Start Authorization ECU, and HSM allows attackers or malicious insiders to deny having performed unauthorized unlock or start commands, complicating post-incident analysis.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The BCM, Door ECU, Start Authorization ECU, and HSM shall enforce the Integrity, Accountability, and Non-repudiation of Door Lock/Unlock Command, Engine Start Command, and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0034: Bypass Mandatory Access Control to prevent denial of unauthorized command execution and hindered post-incident analysis.
